name: vraxis-code
description: A local workspace for directing coding agents and reviewing their work.

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:test-runtime && npm run build:service && npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @vraxis/code-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @vraxis/code-test-runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @vraxis/code-service && npm run typecheck --workspace @vraxis/code-web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-contracts && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-test-runtime && npm run build:test-runtime && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-service && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-web
scripts.test:windows: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-contracts && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-test-runtime && npm run build:test-runtime && npm run test:windows --workspace @vraxis/code-service && npm run test --workspace @vraxis/code-web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:ui && npm run desktop:validate
